caption:
Goat meat in Hyderabad, never frozen: boneless mutton curry in a pressure cooker, ready in 40 minutes 🐐🍛 మటన్ కూర

💬 Mutton curry with rice or with chapati? 👇

Save this weeknight recipe 👇
🛒 You need: 500 g goat boneless · 2 onions, sliced · 2 tomatoes, chopped · 2 green chillies · 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste · ½ tsp turmeric · 1½ tsp red chilli powder · 1 tsp coriander powder · 1 tsp mutton masala · salt · 3 tbsp cold-pressed groundnut oil · coriander leaves
1️⃣ Heat oil in the pressure cooker, fry onions and green chillies till golden.
2️⃣ Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes; cook till soft.
3️⃣ Add the mutton, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder, masala and salt; fry 5 minutes.
4️⃣ Add 1 cup water, close and cook 4 whistles.
5️⃣ Simmer open 5 minutes till thick, finish with coriander.

Goat meat from our own goat farms, at your door in Hyderabad in 60–90 minutes. Never frozen, cut fresh every day.
📊 Per 100 g raw goat meat: protein 20.6 g, iron 2.8 mg, vitamin B12 1.1 µg (Source: USDA FoodData Central)
